# Galičica trails (https://galicica.finereli.com)

> Every marked trail in Galičica National Park (Галичица, also spelled Galicica or Galichica), North Macedonia, between Lake Ohrid and Lake Prespa. All 38 numbered trails (H easier, T harder, G ridges above 1,600 m, MTB bike) with maps, elevation profiles and free GPX, GeoJSON and KML downloads, plus the park's 10 suggested day routes.

Key facts:
- Free, no account, no ads. Open data and open source: https://github.com/finereli/galicica-trails
- Source: the park's own web trail map (NP Galičica), archived by the Wayback Machine in October 2020, before the park took the map down in a site redesign. Cross-checked against OpenStreetMap (within 50 m where both exist). The G-6 line is from OSM.
- Trail codes are the ones on the park's signposts and guideposts.
- Lines were drawn by hand by the park, not GPS-recorded; expect 20 to 50 m error. Conditions are as of 2020.
- All trails in one GPX: https://galicica.finereli.com/gpx/galicica-all-trails.gpx (for AlpineQuest, OsmAnd, Gaia GPS, Locus, Organic Maps, Garmin)
- Recommended phone app: Organic Maps (https://organicmaps.app), free and open source, usable offline (no signal on most of the mountain). Download the North Macedonia map on wifi, then open a trail's GPX with Organic Maps.
- GeoJSON: https://galicica.finereli.com/data/galicica-trails.geojson   KML: https://galicica.finereli.com/data/galicica-trails.kml

## Park suggested routes (official length, time, difficulty per direction)
- Velgoshti - Letnica - Ramne - Ohrid visitor centre (trails T-1, T-2, MTB-1). Velgoshti village, St Petka monastery to Ohrid visitor centre: 12.6 km, 5 h 15 min, moderate; Ohrid visitor centre to Velgoshti village, St Petka monastery: 12.6 km, 5 h, moderate. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/velgoshti-letnica-ramne-ohrid/
- Ramne - Letnica - Visok Vrv - Krstec - Velestovo (trails G-1, T-3, T-2, H-4). Ramne village to Velestovo village: 11.7 km, 5 h 15 min, moderate; Velestovo village to Ramne village: 11.7 km, 4 h 45 min, moderate. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/ramne-letnica-visok-vrv-krstec-velestovo/
- Velestovo - Krstec - Tri Mazhi peak - Studino - Elshani (trails G-2, T-3, T-4, T-5, G-5). Velestovo village to Elshani village: 16.8 km, 7 h, moderate; Elshani village to Velestovo village: 16.8 km, 7 h 30 min, moderate. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/velestovo-krstec-tri-mazhi-studino-elshani/
- Elshani - Bugarska Chuka - Lako Signoj - Galičica pass (trails T-5, G-5). Galičica pass (regional road R-504) to Elshani village: 13.3 km, 5 h 30 min, moderate; Elshani village to Galičica pass (regional road R-504): 13.3 km, 6 h 30 min, hard. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/elshani-bugarska-chuka-lako-signoj-galicica-pass/
- Galičica pass - Magaro peak - Galičica pass (trails G-6). Galičica pass (regional road R-504) to Galičica pass (regional road R-504): 7.7 km, 4 h 30 min, moderate. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/galicica-pass-magaro-loop/
- Dva Javora - Sharbojca house - Samotska Dupka cave - Velestovo (trails T-4, MTB-2, H-7). Dva Javora to Velestovo village: 14.2 km, 5 h 15 min, moderate; Velestovo village to Dva Javora: 14.2 km, 6 h 45 min, moderate. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/dva-javora-sharbojca-samotska-dupka-velestovo/
- Velestovo - Elen Vrv - Konjsko - Elshani (trails T-4, H-5, G-3). Velestovo village to Elshani village: 9.3 km, 2 h 30 min, easy; Elshani village to Velestovo village: 9.3 km, 3 h, easy. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/velestovo-elen-vrv-konjsko-elshani/
- Peshtani - St Spas - Galičica pass - Peshtani (trails T-7, MTB-6, H-9). Peshtani village to Galičica pass (regional road R-504): 8.3 km, 5 h 30 min, moderate; Galičica pass (regional road R-504) to Peshtani village: 8.3 km, 2 h 30 min, easy. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/peshtani-st-spas-galicica-pass-peshtani/
- Oteshevo - Goga peak - Sharbojca mountain house (trails MTB-3, T-6, G-4, MTB-2). Oteshevo to Sharbojca mountain house: 23.4 km, 9 h 45 min, very hard; Sharbojca mountain house to Oteshevo: 23.4 km, 5 h 45 min, hard. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/oteshevo-goga-sharbojca/
- Stenje - Konjsko along Lake Prespa (trails H-13). Stenje to Konjsko (Prespa): 8.4 km, 2 h 15 min, easy; Konjsko (Prespa) to Stenje: 8.4 km, 2 h 15 min, easy. https://galicica.finereli.com/routes/stenje-konjsko-prespa-shore/
